description: Computes the VAT the BUYER (cessionario) must self-assess under the Italian reverse charge and returns both parties' obligations with the applicable law. It separates the three cases most often confused: INTRA-EU reverse charge (non-IT EU supplier — art. 46 DL 331/93 for goods, art. 17 c. 2 DPR 633/72 for services: with 'oggetto' it also says how the supplier invoices and which integration document is needed), DOMESTIC reverse charge (Italian supplier — art. 17 c. 6, which is NOT general: it applies only in listed sectors such as construction subcontracting, scrap, building cleaning, electronics) and non-EU country (explicit error, not an implicit branch). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

imponibile.description: Taxable amount of the invoice in EUR.

oggetto.description: intraUE only: 'beni' (goods) or 'servizi' (services). For goods the EU supplier invoices an exempt intra-EU supply (integration TD18); for services «inversione contabile» (TD17). If missing, the response gives both cases in `per_oggetto`.

paese_cedente.description: ISO2 code of the SUPPLIER's (cedente) country: an EU Member State (e.g. DE, FR, ES; 'EL' or 'GR' for Greece; 'XI' for Northern Ireland) for the intra-EU reverse charge, or 'IT' for the domestic one.

name: calc_reverse_charge
title: Reverse charge (inversione contabile)
